hintText:
Pulsing sphere: radius = A + E*sin(F*t)
It swells into the six tori, merges, then shrinks back. Period ~10.5 s.
implicitEquation: min( sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z) - (A + E*sin(F*t)), min( sqrt((sqrt((abs(x)-D)*(abs(x)-D) + y*y) - B)*(sqrt((abs(x)-D)*(abs(x)-D) + y*y) - B) + z*z) - C, min( sqrt((sqrt((abs(y)-D)*(abs(y)-D) + z*z) - B)*(sqrt((abs(y)-D)*(abs(y)-D) + z*z) - B) + x*x) - C, sqrt((sqrt((abs(z)-D)*(abs(z)-D) + x*x) - B)*(sqrt((abs(z)-D)*(abs(z)-D) + x*x) - B) + y*y) - C ) ) ) = 0
name: Pulsing Sphere and Six Tori
